resources.string: Kaloria reads your step count to show it on Today and Progress, next to your steps goal. It\'s shown as a count only; Kaloria doesn\'t turn steps into calories burned.
Kaloria reads and writes weigh-ins, so weight you log in Kaloria and weight from Samsung Health or a smart scale stay the same in both places. They\'re shown on Progress.
With this, Kaloria can also read weigh-ins from before the last 30 days, so a new install brings in your earlier weight. Sync works without it.

Step counts are only read for display and never stored or sent anywhere. Weigh-ins are kept on this phone and, only if you turn on sync in Settings, on the server you set up yourself. Kaloria has no ads and no analytics.
Kaloria works without Health Connect. You can turn either permission off at any time in Health Connect; weigh-ins already logged in Kaloria stay there.
